question: The value of all final goods and services produced within the country during one year is known as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**gross domestic product**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The value of all final goods and services produced within the country during one year is known as the **gross domestic product (GDP)**.
 
• GDP is a primary indicator used to gauge the health of a country's economy.
 
• It represents the total dollar value of all goods and services produced over a specific time period.
 
• GDP can be calculated using three approaches: the production (or output) approach, the income approach, and the expenditure approach.
 
• It includes all private and public consumption, government outlays, investments, and exports minus imports that occur within a defined territory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross National Product (GNP)** includes GDP plus any income earned by residents from overseas investments, minus income earned within the domestic economy by foreign residents.
 
• **Net National Product (NNP)** is GNP minus depreciation (a measure of the wear and tear on the country's capital goods).
 
• **Net Domestic Product (NDP)** is GDP minus depreciation.
 
• GDP is often adjusted for inflation to reflect real GDP, which provides a more accurate depiction of an economy's size and how it's growing over time.
